statutes.act_name: Federal Decree-Law No. 31/2021 Concerning Crimes and Penalties
statutes.title: Theft of Property (Embezzlement & Larceny)
statutes.description: Any person who unlawfully appropriates moveable property belonging to another with intent to deprive the owner permanently.
statutes.penalty: Detention for a period not less than 6 months or fine.
statutes.court_type: Federal Criminal Court of First Instance

statutes.title: Theft Accompanied by Infiltration or Night Entry
statutes.description: Theft committed during night time or by breaking into inhabited premises or inhabited structures.
statutes.penalty: Imprisonment for a period between 2 to 7 years.

statutes.act_name: Federal Law No. 28/2005 on Personal Status
statutes.title: Dissolution of Marriage for Harm (Divorce)
statutes.description: Either spouse may apply for divorce on grounds of prejudice or harm making continuation of conjugal life impossible.
statutes.court_type: Personal Status Court Dubai / Abu Dhabi

statutes.act_name: Federal Decree-Law No. 33/2021 on Regulation of Labour Relations
statutes.title: Arbitrary Termination & End of Service Gratuity
statutes.description: Termination of employment without valid statutory cause entitles worker to compensation up to 3 months full salary.

statutes.act_name: Federal Decree-Law No. 34/2021 on Combatting Rumors & Cybercrimes
statutes.title: Violation of Privacy & Taking Photographs Without Permission
statutes.description: Eavesdropping, taking photos, or capturing images of any person in a public or private place using electronic devices without consent.
statutes.penalty: Detention for not less than 6 months and fine between AED 150,000 to AED 500,000.
